observation_relations.derivation_method: CL-DATA-77 web verification 2026-11-20: azimuth = initial great-circle bearing (WGS84 geodesic, north=0 clockwise) from the verified camera point to the verified target point, computed with a spherical earth (R=6371km); OSM Nominatim nodes retrieved 2026-11-20. Result: az=284 deg (dist ~0.46 km) — west along the stone causeway to the islet; replaces the legacy V1 weather_details azimuth 270 (CL-DATA-13 backfill), which sits within the same wide tolerance band.
observation_relations.uncertainty_note: Wide tolerance: the causeway curves and the composition includes the islet AND its baroque gate; the legacy 270 and computed 284 agree within ~14 deg.

notes_i18n.zh-TW: CL-DATA-20（2026-11-06）：本筆標記為潮汐主導題材（genre_template=tidal）。支配條件是潮汐（摩西分海／退潮石板道），非天氣；系統現無潮汐資料源，誠實 not_evaluatable 待潮汐模組實作後再建契約，不提供天氣契約以免誤導（2026-11-01 既定語意）。
notes_i18n.en: CL-DATA-20 (2026-11-06): this subject is tidal-governed (genre_template=tidal). The governing condition is the tide (Moses sea-parting / exposed flagstone causeway), not weather; the system has no tidal data source, so it is honestly not_evaluatable until a tidal module is implemented - no weather contract is offered to avoid misleading (established 2026-11-01 semantics).
notes_i18n.ja: CL-DATA-20（2026-11-06）：本件は潮汐支配の題材（genre_template=tidal）。支配的条件は潮汐（モーゼの海割り／干潮で石畳道が露出）であり天気ではない。潮汐データソースが現状ないため、潮汐モジュール実装までは誠実に not_evaluatable。誤解を避けるため気象契約は提供しない（2026-11-01の既定語義）。
